messages.text:
Hi Helium D. team,

I'm Chris R. with RETnetworks. We rent internet routers (5G home,
business and travel setups) to homes, small businesses and folks on the go,
and we share what we learn on our YouTube channel and social pages.

We also run GenXMade, a channel where we use and compare old-school
products and tech with today's new-age versions, head to head.

I already have a Helium D. affiliate account and I'm ready to start
creating content around it. DePIN is right in our wheelhouse: we already
install connectivity gear for customers, and we'd love to show viewers how
to set up, host and earn with the hardware you carry, like Helium hotspots
and the 4DSKY Airsquitter.

Would you be open to sending one or two products to get us started? Here's
what you can expect:
• A dedicated setup and review video on YouTube
• Short clips for YouTube Shorts and Facebook
• Real-world use, not just an unboxing
• Your product and affiliate links in every post
• Positive-only coverage: we only publish videos on products we can
recommend. If something isn't a fit, we'll share our feedback with you
privately instead of posting it.

Our channels:
GenXMade on YouTube: https://www.youtube.com/@GenXMade
Facebook: https://www.facebook.com/profile.php?id=61564509070436

If someone else handles creator or review partnerships, I'd be grateful if
you could point me their way. Thanks for your time. I look forward to
hearing from you!

Chris R.
RETnetworks
(email hidden)
(phone hidden) <(phone hidden)> | retnetworks.com
Handed to the team · Free product for a creator partnership is not mine to approve.

Hi Chris,

Thanks for the detailed note, and for already being on the affiliate side. DePIN plus real install work is a good fit for us, so I've passed your request to Georges, who handles creator partnerships here. The team is offline this evening and picks it up tomorrow at 10am ET, and the reply will come straight to this address.

One thing that will help him decide quickly: the hardware you named sits in two different places. The A. / 4DSKY is $985.83 and in stock, and we carry Helium M. hotspots as well. If there's a specific setup you'd want to film, say which one and roughly when you'd publish, and he can work from that.

Worth saying plainly on one point: we'd rather you cover a unit honestly than only positively. If something underperforms on camera, say so. That reads better to your viewers and it's more useful to us.

Georges will come back to you tomorrow.

Sarah, HeliumDeploy

handoffs: Free product for a creator partnership is not mine to approve.
